issue.summary: Same supplier on 2 different payment terms across ERPs

plan.diagnosis: Bauer Adv. Metals K.K. is configured with inconsistent payment terms across D365 (Net30) and SAP_B (2/10N30), creating a USD 6,057,938 exposure to duplicate discount claims, inconsistent cash flow forecasting, and potential supplier confusion. The mismatch prevents capture of available early payment discounts in D365 while SAP_B offers 2% discount for payment within 10 days, representing a lost opportunity of approximately USD 121,159 annually if early payment terms were harmonized.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct supplier negotiation with Bauer Adv. Metals K.K. to establish single standard payment term (recommend 2/10N30 to capture discount opportunity across full USD 6,057,938 spend base)
Update D365 vendor master to reflect agreed 2/10N30 terms matching SAP_B configuration; enable automatic discount calculation in AP module
Validate SAP_B vendor master (LFB1) payment terms remain at 2/10N30; update purchasing info records and source lists to reflect standardized terms
Implement cross-ERP payment term compliance report in Coupa to flag any future mismatches for this supplier across D365 and SAP_B systems
Train AP teams in both ERPs on new discount capture process and establish KPI tracking for discount realization rate with Bauer Adv. Metals K.K.

plan.expected_impact: Harmonizing to 2/10N30 across both ERPs enables capture of up to USD 121,159 in annual early payment discounts (2% of USD 6,057,938) while eliminating reconciliation costs and payment confusion.
kpis: Early payment discount capture rate for Bauer Adv. Metals K.K. (target 80%+ of invoices paid within 10 days)
Payment term compliance across D365 and SAP_B (target 100% match)
Annual discount dollars realized from Bauer Adv. Metals K.K. (target USD 97,000+)
AP processing time reduction for this supplier (baseline vs. 30 days post-implementation)
risks: Supplier rejects 2/10N30 harmonization and demands Net30 across both ERPs, eliminating USD 121,159 discount opportunity
AP teams fail to process invoices within 10-day discount window, negating financial benefit of term change
Historical open POs in D365 and SAP_B may retain old terms until closed, creating 60-90 day transition period with mixed terms
Cash flow impact if AP begins taking all discounts without treasury planning for accelerated payments on USD 6,057,938 annual spend
erp_actions: D365: Update vendor payment terms from Net30 to 2/10N30 in Accounts Payable > Vendors > Payment setup for Bauer Adv. Metals K.K.
SAP_B: Verify table LFB1 field ZTERM = 2/10N30 for Bauer Adv. Metals K.K. across all company codes; no change required if already correct
D365: Enable automatic cash discount calculation in AP parameters and set discount grace period to 0 days
SAP_B: Review and update all open purchase orders (ME22N) and contracts (ME32K) for Bauer Adv. Metals K.K. to reflect 2/10N30 terms
Coupa: Add Bauer Adv. Metals K.K. to payment term monitoring dashboard with alert threshold for any deviation from 2/10N30 in source ERPs
D365 & SAP_B: Add vendor master data governance rule requiring cross-ERP approval for any payment term changes to this supplier
